serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Lucid Software provides visual collaboration products to support public sector teams from end to end as they ideate, plan, and execute mission-critical projects. Government agencies and contractors use Lucid GovSuite — which includes Lucidchart (intelligent diagramming) and Lucidspark (virtual whiteboard) — to drive efficiency, streamline processes, and accelerate speed to mission delivery. Lucid also offers accelerators for Agile, cloud, and process transformation that, when added to Lucid GovSuite, help organizations streamline workflows, foster alignment, and drive business transformation at scale.
